name: Quinoa Puffs - Dahi Papdi Chaat
ingredients_raw: Quinoa, corn, rice, jowar, oats, gram, potato flakes, edible vegetable oil (rice bran oil). Seasoning: Spices and condiments (garlic, cumin, onion, chilli), hydrolysed vegetable protein (soya), yeast extract powder, edible vegetable oil (sunflower oil), iodised salt, black salt, milk solids, sugar, acidity regulators (INS 262(i), INS 330), anti-caking agents (INS 551, INS 341(iii)), flavour enhancers (INS 627, INS 631).
